**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Forty winks
solution:
The correct answer is **"A short nap."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Forty winks"** is an idiomatic expression that means taking a brief nap or a short sleep. (थोड़ी झपकी लेना या छोटी नींद लेना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The justice was having **forty winks**__ when they entered his office.*
 
 
 
• The phrase is often used to indicate a quick rest, especially during the day.
 
• The term **"winks"** refers to the rapid closing and opening of the eyes, suggesting a momentary sleep.
 
• The phrase** "forty winks"** is often used humorously or playfully to describe a short nap.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
